\section*{AP \({ }^{\text {® }}\) CALCULUS BC \\ 2015 SCORING GUIDELINES}

\section*{Question 2}

At time \(t \geq 0\), a particle moving along a curve in the \(x y\)-plane has position \((x(t), y(t))\) with velocity vector \(v(t)=\left(\cos \left(t^{2}\right), e^{0.5 t}\right)\). At \(t=1\), the particle is at the point \((3,5)\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the \(x\)-coordinate of the position of the particle at time \(t=2\).
\item[(b)] For \(0<t<1\), there is a point on the curve at which the line tangent to the curve has a slope of 2 . At what time is the object at that point?
\item[(c)] Find the time at which the speed of the particle is 3.
\item[(d)] Find the total distance traveled by the particle from time \(t=0\) to time \(t=1\).
\item[(a)] \(x(2)=3+\int_{1}^{2} \cos \left(t^{2}\right) d t=2.557(\) or 2.556 \()\)
\item[(b)] \(\frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{d y / d t}{d x / d t}=\frac{e^{0.5 t}}{\cos \left(t^{2}\right)}\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \frac{e^{0.5 t}}{\cos \left(t^{2}\right)}=2 \\
& t=0.840
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(c)] Speed \(=\sqrt{\cos ^{2}\left(t^{2}\right)+e^{t}}\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \sqrt{\cos ^{2}\left(t^{2}\right)+e^{t}}=3 \\
& t=2.196(\text { or } 2.195)
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(d)] Distance \(=\int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{\cos ^{2}\left(t^{2}\right)+e^{t}} d t=1.595\) (or 1.594)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { integral } \\ 1: \text { uses initial condition } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { slope in terms of } t \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { speed in terms of } t \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { integral } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
